tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background behind every screen. A cool off-white with a slight sage bias, never cream.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, bottom sheets and the tab bar, sitting on `ground`.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and the 1px border of cards and inputs. Decorative only; never the only sign of a control.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All primary text and numbers on `ground` and `surface` (15:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: captions, timestamps, helper text on `ground` and `surface` (5.8:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Bloat's identity colour, a deep sage-teal. Primary buttons, the selected tab, links, the focus ring, and brand text on `ground` and `surface`.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `brand` fill (7.5:1 light, 8.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: brand-tint
tokens.usage: Quiet brand fills: selected chips, the progress counter, the doctor line's background. Text on it uses `ink`.

tokens.name: score-mild
tokens.usage: Bloat Score 1-3 on charts, the calendar and the strength scale. A data mark, not a warning. Labels on it use `ink` (light) or `ground` (dark).

tokens.name: score-moderate
tokens.usage: Bloat Score 4-6. Labels on it use `ink` (light) or `ground` (dark).

tokens.name: score-strong
tokens.usage: Bloat Score 7-8. Labels on it use `ink` (light) or `ground` (dark).

tokens.name: score-severe
tokens.usage: Bloat Score 9-10. Labels on it use `on-score-severe`. Deep clay, deliberately not alarm red: a high score is a record, not an emergency.

tokens.name: on-score-severe
tokens.usage: Labels on a `score-severe` fill (6.6:1 light, 4.8:1 dark).

tokens.name: alert
tokens.usage: Only for the NHS warning-sign chips and their advice text, on `surface` and `ground` (6.5:1 or more in both themes). Never for scores, foods or anything else.

tokens.name: alert-tint
tokens.usage: Background of a selected warning chip and its advice box. Text on it uses `alert` or `ink`.

styles.name: score-number
styles.usage: The big number on Today and the morning review. Tabular figures.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: One per screen, at the top.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Bloating on 15 of the last 30 days.
styles.usage: All running text and list rows. Never smaller on a phone.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Button labels and key values inside sentences.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Small uppercase section labels and chip groups.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Sources, timestamps, day counts, fixed wording under results.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Inside chips; between a number and its unit.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between chips; between a label and its field.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding and the screen side gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between cards and between sections of a screen.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Above a screen headline; around the main button.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs and small tiles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and bottom sheets (top corners).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, the strength scale and the round score badge.
